prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function booleanFlags(input: string): string | null
Behavior: Parse comma-separated key=true or key=false records. Keys use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)* and must be unique. Reject empty input or malformed records. Return enabled keys in ASCII lexicographic order joined by commas; an all-false input returns the empty string.
Visible example: cache=true,trace=false,debug=true returns cache,debug.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
const f:(s:string)=>string|null=(s:string)=>{let d=new Map;if(!s)return null;for(const r of s.split(',')){const p=r.split('=');if(p.length!==2||!/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/.test(p[0])||!['true','false'].includes(p[1])||d.has(p[0]))return null;d.set(p[0],p[1]==='true')}return[...d].filter(x=>x[1]).map(x=>x[0]).sort().join(',')};
export function booleanFlags(input:string):string|null{return f(input)}
